'''Tippet''' was an [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] member of [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]] who helped the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel forces]] fight [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] troops during the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].<ref name="Hasbro">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: Movie Heroes|pack=Ewok Pack|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/Ewok_Pack_2012_Star_Wars_Movie_Heroes_Hasbro.asp}}</ref> He continued to be present in the time leading up to the [[Second Battle of Endor]].<ref name="MC 94" /><ref name="MC 100">[[Star Wars (1977) 100|''Star Wars'' (1977) 100]]</ref>

Tippet was betrothed to [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Kamida]], and when [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] reported impropriety on the part of a [[Lahsbee/Huhk|Lahsbee]] ambassador, he declared war on the Lahsbee. The incident had actually been manufactured by [[Executive officer/Legends|First Officer]] [[Hirog]] of the [[Hiromi Empire]], who was trying to unbalance the Alliance to make it easier to conquer.<ref name="MC 94" />

As the Ewok warriors mobilized, donning [[Stormtrooper armor/Legends|stormtrooper armor]], [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] managed to convince the two beings to settle the matter in an honor duel, rather than dragging the entire [[Alliance of Free Planets]] into a civil war. The fight appeared to be one-sided until the Lahsbee morphed into a ferocious Huhk. When the other Lahsbee joined the fight to subdue their fellow representative, the situation was resolved as the two species saw they could work together.<ref name="MC 94" />

Later, Tippet alerted [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] to [[Nagai/Legends|Nagai]] troops preparing for a ground attack while Alliance ships fought a Nagai fleet above the forest moon.<ref name="MC 100" />

==Behind the scenes==
The character's name may have been influenced by that of visual-effects artist [[Phil Tippett]], who worked on [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''The Empire Strikes Back'']] and [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Return of the Jedi'']]; that of the Ewok [[Nippet/Legends|Nippet]], who appeared in ''Return of the Jedi''; or both.

In [[2012]], [[Hasbro]] made an action figure of Tippet. It was included in a [[Toys "R" Us]]&ndash;exclusive Ewok pack.<ref name="Hasbro" />
